# CI workflow notice

The reusable workflows in `node-ci.yml`, `release-reusable.yml`, and
`workflow-lint-reusable.yml`, plus the Dependabot configuration, are adapted
from [speedysebi/cicd-template](https://github.com/speedysebi/cicd-template)
at commit `2845d4260152eb65a354192f4e996bd9bc3e7f24` (the `v1` tag at
integration time). The zizmor configuration is adapted from commit
`24815005fd174be1e852505f664d40ec8d348bfb`. The template is private;
these files are kept locally so this public repository can run them.
